data.name: Guillermina
data.gender_notes: Guillermina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Latin 'Guilielmus' meaning 'will, desire, or determination of a warrior'. In Christianity, Guillermina is a variation of the name Guadalupe, which is associated with the Virgin of Guadalupe, the patron saint of Mexico. The name Guillermina carries the meaning “Will, power of a warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Guillermina usually hope their child will grow to embody will, power of a warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, devotion, and determination in faith.
data.etymology: Guillermina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Will, power of a warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Guillermina total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: גוילרמינה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא הקפטן שלי, אלוהים הוא השליט שלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גוילרמינה מקורו בשם הגרמני 'וילהלמינה', שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא הקפטן שלי' או 'אלוהים הוא השליט שלי'. השם מורכב מהמילים 'ויל' ו'הלם', שפירושם 'רצון' ו'קסדה' או 'מגן', בהתאמה. השם נמצא בשימוש נרחב במסורת הנוצרית והוא קשור לשמו של הקדוש ויליאם.

in_greek.name: Γουιλλερμίνα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο προστάτης μου, ο Θεός είναι ο κυρίαρχός μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γουιλλερμίνα προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα 'Wilhelmine', που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο προστάτης μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κυρίαρχός μου'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από τις λέξεις 'wil' και 'helm', που σημαίνει 'θέληση' και 'κάπνο' ή 'ασπίδα', αντίστοιχα. Το όνομα χρησιμοποιείται ευρέως στην χριστιανική παράδοση και συνδέεται με το όνομα του Αγίου Γουλιέλμου.

in_latin.name: Guillermina
in_latin.meaning: Deus est meus protector, Deus est meus dominus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Guillermina originem habet ex nomine Germanico 'Wilhelmine', quod significat 'Deus est meus protector' vel 'Deus est meus dominus'. Nomen componitur ex vocibus 'wil' et 'helm', quae significant 'voluntas' et 'galea' seu 'scutum', respective. Nomen in traditione Christiana usu venit et cum nomine Sancti Guillelmi coniungitur.

in_english.name: Guillermina
in_english.meaning: God is my protector, God is my ruler
in_english.long_meaning: The name Guillermina originates from the Germanic name 'Wilhelmine', meaning 'God is my protector' or 'God is my ruler'. It is derived from the words 'wil' and 'helm', signifying 'will' and 'helmet' or 'shield', respectively. Guillermina is used in Christian tradition and is associated with the name of Saint William. The name conveys a sense of divine protection and guidance, reflecting the importance of faith and trust in God. Historically, the name has been popularized through various cultural and linguistic adaptations.

data.cultural_impact: Guillermina is a popular given name in the Spanish-speaking world, originating from the Latin name Guilielmus. The name has a rich history and cultural significance in Hispanic cultures, primarily due to its association with the revered Virgin of Guadalupe, whose feast day is widely celebrated in Mexico and other Spanish-speaking countries. This historical and cultural connection to the Virgin of Guadalupe imbues the name with a powerful symbolism of motherhood, protection, and faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Guillermina holds significant spiritual meaning for many within the Christian faith, particularly those of Hispanic origin. With its connection to the name Guadalupe, Guillermina represents astrong affirmation of faith and spiritual devotion. The name reminds us of the Virgin Mary's unwavering love, protection, and motherly care, which are valued attributes for countless believers. Furthermore, it is a constant reminder of the Virgin of Guadalupe's profound impact on the religious and cultural identity of both Mexico and the broader Spanish-speaking world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Guillermina: Devoted to William, bearer of great strength and will. Inspired by the courage and wisdom of St. William of Aquitaine.

historical_references.reference: Guillermina of Aragon, born in 1480, was the eldest daughter of King Ferdinand II of Aragon and Queen Isabella I of Castile. She was named after her grandmother, Queen Guillermina of Aragon (1428-1445), who was the mother of Ferdinand II.
historical_references.context: During the time of the Catholic Monarchs' reign in Spain.

historical_references.reference: Guillermina of Luxembourg (1526-1568), was the youngest daughter of Duke Charles of Luxembourg. She became the wife of Philip II of Spain in 1543, and was named after her mother, Duchess Guillermina of Jülich-Cleves-Berg (1492-1558).
historical_references.context: During the Habsburg Dynasty's rule in Europe.
